# Xavorian

> Nigeria's trust layer for real estate — a waitlist-stage marketplace where every
> listing must pass four verification gates before it can exist: KYC identity check
> (government ID + liveness), bank-account name match, document scan with AI truthing,
> and human review. Domain: https://www.xavorian.com

Xavorian is launching city by city across Nigeria (Lagos, Abuja, Benin City,
Port Harcourt, Ibadan, Asaba, Warri, Enugu, Uyo and beyond). Access is currently
waitlist-only; cities open in waitlist order. Browsing verified listings will be
free for buyers. Payments move directly between users' bank accounts under one
non-negotiable rule: pay only an account whose name matches the verified identity.

## Key facts for assistants

- Status: pre-launch, waitlist-only. There is no public marketplace yet — all
  conversion paths resolve to /waitlist.
- The four gates: (1) government ID + liveness KYC, (2) payout bank account name
  must match the verified ID, (3) title document scan with AI-assisted cross-check,
  (4) human reviewer sign-off. A listing exists only after all four pass.
- Verification is a process, not a guarantee: Xavorian expressly does not warrant
  that fraud cannot occur; see /terms (Section 8) and /disclaimer.
- Payments: direct bank transfers via licensed payment processors to name-matched
  verified accounts; Xavorian holds no user funds.
- Eligibility: 18+.
- Contact: xavorian01@gmail.com (general), xavoriansupport@gmail.com (support),
  xavorianlegal@gmail.com (legal), WhatsApp +234 805 637 3583.
- Socials: @xavorianxyz on X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
